::: {.research-core}
[Core expertise]{.core-label}

[Lightweight deep learning for **time-series classification**]{.core-title}

[Many real-world signals arrive as streams over time, from the movements of a person's eyes to the counters of a network router. I design compact, fast models that recognise patterns in these signals with short input windows and modest hardware, so they can run close to where the data is produced.]{.core-text}

[<i class="bi bi-lightning-charge"></i> Short input windows & low latency]{.core-chip} [<i class="bi bi-cpu"></i> Small models for modest hardware]{.core-chip} [<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Transfer learning for scarce data]{.core-chip}
:::

::: {.research-domains}
[[<i class="bi bi-eye"></i>]{.domain-icon}[Application domain]{.domain-label}[Human sensing: eye movements]{.domain-title}[Classifying fixations, saccades, and other eye movements from gaze signals for assistive and gaze-based interaction.]{.domain-text}[Master's thesis · ICADEIS 2025 review](publications.qmd){.domain-link}]{.domain-card}
[[<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>]{.domain-icon}[Application domain]{.domain-label}[Network operations: fault identification]{.domain-title}[Identifying the type and cause of network faults from time-series telemetry, framed as a classification problem.]{.domain-text}[Funded project, 2026](#project-rca-network-faults){.domain-link}]{.domain-card}
:::

[**Earlier work:** efficient medical image processing — fast ellipse fitting for fetal head measurement on ultrasound images ([TENCON 2024](publications.qmd)).]{.earlier-work}

Students are welcome in two ways: **join one of my research projects** as a research assistant, or **do your final project (Tugas Akhir)** on a topic I supervise. Often the two go together.

## How to Apply {#how-to-apply}

1. **Pick** a position or topic above (or describe your own idea).
2. **Email me** using the *Apply* / *Discuss this topic* button, attaching a short CV, your latest transcript, and two or three sentences on why it interests you.
3. **Meet** for a 20-minute chat about the scope, timeline, and expectations.
4. **Start** with a small warm-up task so we both know it is a good fit.

```{=html}
<script>
// Filter status topik (All / Available / Ongoing / Taken)
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var bar = document.querySelector(".topic-filter");
  if (!bar) return;
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll(".topic-card");
  bar.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest(".topic-filter-btn");
    if (!btn) return;
    var s = btn.getAttribute("data-status");
    bar.querySelectorAll(".topic-filter-btn").forEach(function (b) {
      b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b === btn ? "true" : "false");
    });
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      c.hidden = s !== "all" && c.getAttribute("data-status") !== s;
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
